conclave.definition: n. a confidential or secret meeting
conclave.translation: n. 秘密会议, 教皇选举会议, 红衣主教团

conclaves.definition: n. a confidential or secret meeting
conclaves.translation: n. 秘密会议, 教皇选举会议, 红衣主教团( conclave的复数形式 )

conclavist.definition:
n. One of the two ecclesiastics allowed to attend a
   cardinal in the conclave.
conclavist.translation: n. 红衣主教, 教皇所带的侍从

conclude.definition:
v. bring to a close
v. reach a conclusion after a discussion or deliberation
v. come to a close
v. reach agreement on
conclude.translation:
vt. 结束, 作结论, 推断
vi. 结束, 推断

conclude a treaty with.translation:
和...订立条约
[法] 与...订立条约

concluded.translation: v. 结束( conclude的过去式和过去分词 ); 得出结论; 断定; 推断出

concludes.definition:
v decide by reasoning; draw or come to a conclusion
v bring to a close
v reach a conclusion after a discussion or deliberation
v come to a close
v reach agreement on
concludes.translation: v. 结束( conclude的第三人称单数 ); 得出结论; 断定; 推断出

concluding.definition: s. occurring at or forming an end or termination
concluding.translation: a. 结束的, 最后的

conclusion.definition:
n. an intuitive assumption
n. the proposition arrived at by logical reasoning (such as the proposition that must follow from the major and minor premises of a syllogism)
n. a final settlement
n. the last section of a communication
conclusion.translation:
n. 结论, 结尾, 推论
[法] 缔结, 结论, 推论

conclusion of an expert witness.translation: [法] 鉴定证人的鉴定报告

conclusion of trial.translation: [法] 审判终结, 审判结论

conclusions.definition:
n. a position or opinion or judgment reached after consideration
n. an intuitive assumption
n. the temporal end; the concluding time
conclusions.translation: n. 结束( conclusion的复数形式 ); 结论; 推论; 签订

conclusive.definition: a. forming an end or termination; especially putting an end to doubt or question
conclusive.translation:
a. 决定性的, 确定性的, 最后的
[法] 决定性的, 不容置疑的, 确实的

conclusive presumption.translation: [法] 决定性推定, 绝对推定

conclusively.translation: adv. 最后, 释疑, 确定性, 结论性

conclusiveness.definition: n the quality of being final or definitely settled
conclusiveness.translation: n. 最后, 释疑, 确定性, 结论性

conclusory.translation:
推断性的
没有证据的
